verdict: Sales are working, lead capture is broken — purchases pay back seven-to-one while lead volume stalls.
diagnosis: Spend of $5,675 drove only 2 leads at $12 each, but 9 purchases returned $5,897 in revenue this period.

signals.headline: Return on ad spend hit 7.21x
signals.detail: Every dollar spent returned $7.21 in purchase revenue this period. Strong efficiency on the sales side of the funnel.

signals.headline: Only 2 leads captured in 28 days
signals.detail: Lead volume is critically low despite the campaign being tagged as a leads objective. Form or tracking likely broken.

signals.headline: 138 landing page views, 22 add-to-carts
signals.detail: Roughly 1 in 6 visitors added to cart. Traffic quality is decent; the drop-off happens further down.

signals.headline: Cost per click sits at $2.22
signals.detail: Above the health and wellness search benchmark near $1.63. Keyword targeting on 'life alert' is likely competitive.

signals.headline: 3,106 clicks produced 9 purchases
signals.detail: Click-to-purchase conversion is roughly 0.3%. Well below the 6% health and wellness search benchmark.

recommendations.title: Audit lead form and pixel tracking this week
recommendations.detail: Only 2 leads recorded against 2,236 unique clickers suggests broken form submission or tracking. Test the form yourself and verify the lead pixel fires.

recommendations.title: Double down on the purchase funnel
recommendations.detail: Purchases returned $5,897 at 7.21x return. Consider shifting budget toward the purchase-optimized ad sets and expanding the retargeting pool beyond 50% video viewers.

recommendations.title: Test tighter keyword match on 'life alert'
recommendations.detail: Cost per click of $2.22 is above category norms. Worth testing phrase or exact match and adding negatives like 'jobs' or 'free' to trim wasted spend.
